query: I want to fetch data from a REST API, transform it, and store it in my database. How should I structure this workflow?
expected_behavior: Identifies this as an HTTP API Integration pattern
Prefers the service's own node over HTTP Request when n8n has one
Explains the structure: Trigger → HTTP Request → Transform → Database → Error Handler
Recommends HTTP Request's pagination option (with a page cap), or the service node's Return All, for paged APIs — not a Code/IF loop
Suggests retry logic for API failures
Maps fields in the database node's column slots (Split Out when the body wraps an array) rather than adding a Code or Set node
